title: Intraday Replay CSV Row
description: Each row must be valid on its own: quote_time is zero-padded HH:MM:SS; numeric fields are finite; price, bar_high, and bar_low are positive, with bar_low <= price <= bar_high. If volume_since_open is positive, amount_since_open must also be positive so VWAP cannot collapse to zero. Across rows, amount_since_open and volume_since_open must be non-decreasing per ts_code after sorting by quote_time, and each ts_code + quote_time point must appear at most once.
